$comment: Generated by pnpm features:sync from packages/features/src/registry.ts. Only config.deployment and config.features are constrained.

deployment.description: Which product this install is. Only OpenWork Cloud sets "cloud". Renders DEN_DEPLOYMENT.

nativeDictation.description: Native dictation: Dictate editable prompts in OpenWork and Workbot using native desktop dictation or live browser speech recognition. Renders DEN_FEATURE_NATIVE_DICTATION.

organizationGrants.description: Organization control panel and grants: Platform admins control complimentary access and grant organizations extra or unlimited Free Auto usage, with optional expiration. Renders DEN_FEATURE_ORGANIZATION_GRANTS.

liveProviderSync.description: Live provider sync: Keep desktop OpenCode v2 models up to date with the organization's AI Gateway in real time. Renders DEN_FEATURE_LIVE_PROVIDER_SYNC.

managedDeployments.description: Managed deployments: Organization admins install OpenWork in their own AWS account or Google Cloud project and see its health and updates in OpenWork, and agents connected to OpenWork can create and follow those deployments. Renders DEN_FEATURE_MANAGED_DEPLOYMENTS.

workbotDocuments.description: Workbot Documents: Members browse recent Google Drive files and folders in Workbot, open documents in tabs, and save supported text and spreadsheet edits to Drive. Renders DEN_FEATURE_WORKBOT_DOCUMENTS.

workbotDocumentEditing.description: Workbot Documents: editing: Members choose Edit from a document preview. Full Office editing starts their Cloud workspace only when requested. Requires Workbot Documents. Renders DEN_FEATURE_WORKBOT_DOCUMENT_EDITING.

workbotWorkspaceAssistant.description: Workbot: workspace assistant: Members ask Workbot about the document or calendar view they have open, chat without leaving their work, and navigate from a compact sidebar. Workbot offers to open the documents it mentions, and the conversation stays open beside the document. Renders DEN_FEATURE_WORKBOT_WORKSPACE_ASSISTANT.

automationCalendar.description: Calendar: desktop app: Members see a Calendar in the desktop app with their Automations next to meetings from their connected Google or Outlook calendar. Renders DEN_FEATURE_AUTOMATION_CALENDAR.

engineV2ForceUpgrade.description: Upgrade to OpenCode v2: Desktop and web instances still on OpenCode v1 copy their chats with a backup and switch to OpenCode v2 automatically when idle. Renders DEN_FEATURE_ENGINE_V2_FORCE_UPGRADE.

computerUse.description: Computer use: Let agents use Mac apps or a managed cloud desktop with a live view and Take over and Stop controls. While enabled, requested apps and windows open directly without additional OpenWork approval prompts. GUI access is experimental and is not sandboxed by structured-tool permission rules. Renders DEN_FEATURE_COMPUTER_USE.

browserFloatingView.description: Desktop: floating and full-screen browser: The built-in browser can float as a small live card over the chat, sit beside it, or fill the window, with a Browser button in the chat header that shows when it needs the person. Renders DEN_FEATURE_BROWSER_FLOATING_VIEW.

remoteComputers.description: Desktop: computer use on remote computers: Use a Linux cloud computer with its browser and desktop in OpenWork Web, or connect a VM from Desktop. Configured and conversation-owned desktops open directly when enabled, including follow-ups and internal session renewal. Take over and Stop stay available. Renders DEN_FEATURE_REMOTE_COMPUTERS.

remoteSessionSubagents.description: Desktop: tasks on other computers as sub-agents: A task the agent starts on the cloud or another computer shows in the chat like a sub-agent: whether it is working, needs an answer or finished, and its conversation, which people can open, follow up on and stop. Renders DEN_FEATURE_REMOTE_SESSION_SUBAGENTS.

composerContextIndicators.description: Desktop: context and connectors in the chat box: Next to the model picker, people see how full the model's context is, with a breakdown of what fills it, and which connectors are connected. Renders DEN_FEATURE_COMPOSER_CONTEXT_INDICATORS.
